teachingCards.content:
Categories: Matter • Energy

Sort each word under Matter or Energy.

teachingCards.title: Thematic Rationale
teachingCards.content: Heat, light, and electricity are all forms of energy — they act on things but have no mass of their own. A solid and a particle are both matter, physical substance occupying space.

teachingCards.title: Word Meanings
teachingCards.content:
Heat: energy transferred because of temperature difference
Solid: matter that holds a fixed shape
Particle: a tiny piece of physical substance
Electricity: energy carried by moving electric charge
Light: energy travelling as visible radiation

relatedWords: Heat: energy transferred because of temperature difference
Solid: matter that holds a fixed shape
Particle: a tiny piece of physical substance
Electricity: energy carried by moving electric charge
Light: energy travelling as visible radiation
rawExtra.correctAnswer: Energy:Heat, Matter:Solid, Matter:Particle, Energy:Electricity, Energy:Light

quests.instruction: One matter word names the measure of how much substance something contains. Sort into Energy or Matter.
quests.definition: Radiation and 'kinetic' both describe energy, with kinetic energy being the energy of motion. Mass measures how much substance something contains, atoms are its building blocks, and 'molecule' names atoms bonded together.
quests.example: Mass: a measure of how much substance an object contains | Radiation: energy emitted as waves or particles | Kinetic: relating to motion and its energy | Atom: the basic building block of matter | Molecule: two or more atoms bonded together

quests.contextSentence: Radiation and 'kinetic' both describe energy, with kinetic energy being the energy of motion. Mass measures how much substance something contains, atoms are its building blocks, and 'molecule' names atoms bonded together.
relatedWords: Mass: a measure of how much substance an object contains
Radiation: energy emitted as waves or particles
Kinetic: relating to motion and its energy
Atom: the basic building block of matter
Molecule: two or more atoms bonded together
quests.nativeTip: Weight and mass aren't quite the same thing — one measures substance itself.

quests.definition: 'Power output' and 'stored potential' both describe energy, with potential energy being energy held ready to be released. 'Physical substance' and 'occupies space' both define matter, and 'density' measures how tightly matter is packed.
quests.example: Density: how tightly matter is packed into a space | Power output: the rate at which energy is delivered | Stored potential: energy held ready to be released | Occupies space: takes up physical volume | Physical substance: material that physically exists
